properties.biography: Wesley Schultz and Jeremiah Fraites founded The Lumineers in the mid-2000s and developed a direct, acoustic-driven songwriting approach that foregrounded story-based lyrics and communal-sounding choruses. The group expanded their palette on subsequent records—Cleopatra (2016), the concept-driven III (2019) and Brightside (2022)—while maintaining a focus on raw, singalong arrangements, cello and piano textures, and themes of loss, home and resilience. Touring has been central to their identity, with energetic, participatory live shows that feature stomps, handclaps and close harmonies.
